arabic text: Detey hain sada sarey azadar alamdar
english translation text: All the mourners still call out: Alamdar, Alamdar.

arabic text: Har ek azadar e hussain ibn e ali ka, Har ek wafadar e hussain ibn\ne ali ka\nDil teri mohabat se hai sarshar alamdar
english translation text: Every mourner of Hussain son of Ali, every\nloyal servant of Hussain son of Ali, has\na heart overflowing with love for you, Alamdar.

arabic text: Saqa e haram qafla salar e hussaini, Sab teri qayadat me thy ansar\ne hussaini\nShabir pe jan deney ko tayar alamdar
english translation text: O water-bearer of the sanctuary and leader of Hussain's caravan,\nall the companions of Hussain stood beneath your command,\nready to sacrifice their lives for Shabbir, Alamdar.

arabic text: Qabzey me ho pani wo magar lab na karey tar, Piyasa hi chala\naye jo darya se palat kar\nDekha na kahi aisa wafadar alamdar
english translation text: Though the water was within his grasp, he did not moisten his lips;\nhe returned from the river still thirsty.\nNever has such loyalty been seen, Alamdar.

arabic text: Tum aisey alamdar hussain ibn e ali ke, Har jang k medan me\nmohamad ke the jesey,\nHar ek qadam haider e karar alamdar
english translation text: You were such a standard-bearer for Hussain son of Ali,\nas Muhammad was in every battlefield;\nat every step, you were Haider-e-Karrar, Alamdar.

arabic text: Zalim ka bayan dono jahan tak nahi milta, No lakh ke lashkar ka\nnishan tak nahi milta\nMil jati agar apko talwar alamdar
english translation text: Had you received your sword,\nno trace of the army of nine hundred thousand would have remained.\nThe tyrants' story would have disappeared from both worlds, Alamdar.

arabic text: Jab bad terey khemey jalatey thy sitamgar, Darya ki taraf dekh k\nhar ek sitam par\nDeti thi sada zainb e ghamkhar alamdar
english translation text: When the oppressors burned the tents after you,\nwith every cruelty Zainab looked towards the river\nand called out in grief: Alamdar.

arabic text: Zakhmi hoey rukhsar terey dil ki makeen ke, Ta marg bhi har ek\ntamachey pe laeen ke\nYad aya bhatijee ko tera pyar alamdar
english translation text: The cheeks of the one who lived within your heart were wounded;\nuntil death, with every slap from the accursed one,\nyour niece remembered your love, Alamdar.

arabic text: Dekhey gey 'Karim' or ye 'Salman' bhi jaldi Wo din na rahey dur\nk aney ko hen Mehdi Or hogi yahan apki sarkar alamdar
english translation text: O "Karim" and "Salman", we will soon behold that day; Mahdi's coming\nis not far, and your rule will be established here, Alamdar.
